english:
Scoring 3 non-simultaneous Power Grenade Launcher hits within 3 seconds, a single non-lethal Primary or Special Grenade Launcher hit that does not deal damage over time, or 5 damage-over-time hits counted up to once every 0.5 seconds releases a Shockwave underneath the enemy.

The Shockwave stuns <unstoppable/>Unstoppable Champions and deals <pve 227x2 /> <pvp [?] /> Kinetic damage out to 7 meters, <pve 454 /> <pvp [?] /> in total. Primary and Special Grenade Launchers only deal <pve 150x2 /> <pvp [?] /> damage. The Shockwave has no damage falloff.

Hits count again after a 1 second cooldown.

Dealing Grenade Launcher damage grants a stack of Rapid Impacts for 5 seconds. Maximum of 5 stacks.

Rapid Impacts benefits at 1|2|3|4|5 stacks:
• 5|10|15?|20?|30 Reload Speed
• 1%|1%|2%|4%|6% decreased Reload Animation Duration

source.text:
Releases a single Unstoppable-staggering Shockwave underneath the enemy.
Shockwave deals 227x2 = 454 Kinetic Damage over 7 meters.
Shockwaves from Primary and Special GLs only deal 150x2 Damage.
Shockwave has no damage falloff.
Incurs a 1 second cooldown upon triggering before hits count again.

Triggering Kinetic Impacts:
By scoring 3 non-simultaneous Power GL damage instances within 3 seconds of each.
By scoring a single non-lethal non-DoT Primary/Special GL damage instance.
By scoring a total of 5 DoT damage instances, counted up to once every 0.5 seconds.

-------------------------------------------

Upon dealing Grenade Launcher Damage:
Grants a stack of Rapid Impacts for 5 seconds, up to a maximum of 5 stacks.

+5 | +10 | +15? | +20? | +30 Reload Speed
0.99x | 0.99x | 0.98x | 0.96x | 0.94x Duration Multiplier
